data.name: Energumen
data.description: 1/day, you can open your soul to a demonic spirit as a free action. This spirit possesses you for %1 rounds, granting a +%2 bonus to an ability score of your choice. When the energumen ends, you become confused for %1 rounds as the demonic spirit has its way with your mind. At the start of each round of confusion, you can make a DC 25 Will save to end the confusion effect immediately. Energumen is a possession effect and is negated by protection from evil or protection from chaos. Being affected by such a spell prevents both the benefits and the confusion.|DemoniacLVL|DemoniacEnergumen*2|PREVARLT:DemoniacEnergumen,2
